## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance / Latency optimization

## How Has This Been Tested?
- [ ] Tested on Windows Desktop
- [ ] Tested on Android (Chrome / Native App)
- [ ] Tested on iOS (Safari / PWA)
- [ ] Latency & benchmark verified (<3ms)

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (Zero-Emoji, OffBit typography)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have updated corresponding documentation
